# odd-button — current context

Design-mode discovery, 2026-11-15. Source checkout: `codex/primitive-architect`, HEAD `e44c4fe4aff1b210cfff590fe908b93c88369ab7`, with the owner's existing uncommitted Primitive Architect/ORCP work. Button source had no dirty paths when inspected. The adjacent Avatar and Badge assignments do not authorize runtime changes here.

## Identity and responsibility

`odd-button` is a public foundational interaction primitive in `@oddkin/components`. Its essential responsibility is a named action with native button activation/focus, optional local binary pressed state, explicit loading/disabled state, and the documented form proxy. It is not an operation record, navigation link, status notification, menu, tooltip, or identity renderer. Contextual complexity is **intrinsic**, under [ORCP](../../../responsive-context.md); ordinary allocation requires CSS rather than a context subscriber, resize observer, or resolver.

## Verified source locators

| Concern | Authored source |
| --- | --- |
| Properties, events, local pressed state, form proxy, limitations | `packages/components/src/button/button.ts` |
| Native focus target and slots | `packages/components/src/button/button.template.ts` |
| Intrinsic layout and wrapping | `packages/components/src/button/button.structural.styles.ts` |
| Semantic skin and states | `packages/components/src/button/button.styles.ts` |
| Native `<button class="odd-button">` alternative | `packages/components/src/button/button.native.styles.ts`, published as `@oddkin/components/css/button.css` |
| Definition and extension surface | `button.definition.ts`, `index.ts`, `foundation.ts` in that folder |
| Registration only | `button.define.ts` |
| Development usage and documented incorrect examples | `button.examples.ts` |
| Shared primitives | `packages/components/src/styles/{host,focus-ring,spinner}.styles.ts`; `form-control/description.ts` |
| Existing executable coverage, inspected but not rerun in this design slice | `packages/components/test/button.browser.test.ts`; `styling.browser.test.ts`; `styling-contract.browser.test.ts`; `figma-parity.forms.browser.test.ts` |
| Theme/preset authority | `packages/tokens/themes/default.theme.json`; `packages/tokens/src/generate/preset.ts` |

The current template renders `<button type="button" part="control">`, a decorative spinner, logical `start`, default label, and `end` slots. Its native control is disabled for `disabled`/disabled fieldset, but uses `aria-disabled="true"` for loading so focus can remain. Long unbroken labels already use `overflow-wrap: anywhere`; existing narrow-container source tests cover this direction. No universal claim about every parent composition follows from those inspected tests.

## Canonical decisions and source boundaries

Accepted ADR0001 owns change control; ADR0003 owns typed properties; ADR0004 owns scoped resources/reconnection; ADR0036/0043 own definitions/dependencies; ADR0038/0046 own CSS compatibility/browser floor; ADR0041/0042 own semantic colors and authored noncolor scales; ADR0045 owns appearance, size, loading, pressed, logical slots and event vocabulary. ADR0051 is the **Proposed** public CSS-first ORCP candidate, not catalog-wide acceptance. No new global decision or public layout API is justified by Button.

The source-qualified additional audit on `6eeaff05460d397536af424cf3ef28619b7576b9` calls Button a foundational primitive; it is supporting historical evidence, not this checkout's runtime. The current `design/figma/reuse.json` maps leading icons to author-provided `start` content and busy drawing to the shared spinner. Figma page/node identity, actual variables, and visual verification are recorded by the batch author rather than invented in this source report.

## Consumers and batch order

Source-inspected direct `buttonDefinition` dependencies include AI ActionApproval, Message, Citation, ResponseFeedback, Checkpoint, PromptInput, ChangeReview and Question. Card/Alert/CheckboxGroup examples compose public buttons. Calendar/ColorPicker use the native button CSS path; they do not acquire an `odd-button` runtime dependency. This is a bounded source search, not a complete transitive catalog.

Avatar and Badge have no source-backed Button dependency, and Button has no Avatar/Badge dependency. Each can be specified independently; any combined identity/action row is a host composition. Shared button reuse in those examples must not make Avatar or Badge intrinsically interactive. Design examples may be assembled after the Button baseline is established; no order requires code migration.

## Proposed work versus current behavior

Preserve the current public API and native path. Refine the visual specification with complete themed state coverage, long-label intrinsic wrapping, bounded-host action reachability and stable loading allocation. The source currently inserts/removes a spinner in the flex sequence and does **not** promise stable intrinsic width across loading. The proposed internal loading treatment is a centered shared spinner over layout-retained, opacity-hidden content. It retains the existing accessible name, slot measurements, and native control while avoiding neighbor movement. This proposed visual/template change is not implemented by the design assignment. See [contract](./contract.md), [decision](./decision.md), [research](./research.md), [token map](./token-map.md), and `source-snapshot.json`.

## Live Figma identity

[Dedicated Button specification](https://www.figma.com/design/E7LfRysny8V3qU24tv082i/Oddkin---Design-Framework?node-id=1398-2): page `1398:2`, canonical component sets `159:439`, `181:2332`, `181:2390`, `159:501`, states review `1398:76`, allocation review `1398:2328`, flows `1398:2658`, native spec `1398:2760`. [Authoring evidence](./figma-evidence.json) records actual identities; refinement and final rendered review are separately scoped. These IDs do not certify runtime implementation.

# odd-button — design and implementation contract

Design assignment, 2026-11-15. The current source is recorded in [context](./context.md) and `source-snapshot.json`. Existing behavior below is a source observation; new requirements are **Proposed** until implemented and verified. Figma evidence and browser/AT evidence are independent.

## 1. Purpose, classification and owners

Foundational interaction primitive, ORCP **intrinsic**. The component owns a named action surface, native control/focus, local hover/active/focus and optional binary `pressed` state. Host owns supplied label/icons, `loading`, permission/`disabled`, application operation/record, progress/result messages, retry policy, post-action navigation and focus destinations. The actual form owns validation, submitted data and reset. No record/controller is added to Button.

## 2. Existing public API

All scalar declarations use attributes unless explicitly noted; reflection remains opt-in. Invalid enums diagnose and fall back to their declared default; boolean attribute presence means true, including `disabled="false"`. No object/controller property or new universal layout option is proposed.

| Property / attribute | Type and default | Reflection / responsibility |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `appearance` | `'primary' \| 'secondary' \| 'ghost'`, secondary | Reflected; visual emphasis. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'`, md | Reflected; token-backed minimum height/padding/type. |
| `type` | `'button' \| 'submit' \| 'reset'`, button | Not reflected; form behavior. This default differs from a native submit button. |
| `disabled` | boolean false | Reflected; suppresses activation and native focus. Effective disabled also includes disabled fieldset. |
| `loading` | boolean false | Reflected; spinner and activation suppression with focusability retained. Does not imply pending network state or successful outcome. |
| `fullWidth` / `full-width` | boolean false | Reflected; fills its parent's inline allocation, not the viewport. |
| `toggle` | boolean false | Reflected; enables local binary pressed behavior and `aria-pressed`. |
| `pressed` | boolean false | Reflected; canonical binary state when toggle is enabled. Programmatic updates emit no user events. |
| `label` | string `''` | Not reflected; accessible name override for icon-only content. Visible wording should be included in an override. |
| `name`, `value` | strings `''` | Not reflected; passed to temporary submitter only when activated. |
| `formAction`/`formaction`, `formMethod`/`formmethod`, `formEnctype`/`formenctype`, `formTarget`/`formtarget` | optional strings; absent unless supplied | Reflected. Raw attribute text is returned, not resolved URL/form defaults. Passed to native proxy unchanged. |
| `formNoValidate` / `formnovalidate` | boolean false | Reflected; proxy bypasses validation. |
| `form` | readonly `HTMLFormElement \| null` | Getter from ElementInternals, with native `form` ID association/position ownership. |

Inherited HTMLElement `focus()`, `blur()`, `click()` remain platform methods. The class's `formDisabledCallback` is a native lifecycle hook; `_describe`, `_externalDescription` and `_formDisabled` are internal implementation details. No `save()`, `cancel()`, outcome method, public `compact`, `tone`, `icon`, `responsive`, `open`, `status`, `href` or `presentation` is added.

## 3. Anatomy and extension

| Hook | Existing contract |
| --- | --- |
| Default slot | Canonical action text / icon-only content; names the native control unless label is supplied. |
| `start`, `end` slots | Logical noninteractive adornments; mirror with direction. Authors provide icon artwork. |
| `part="control"` | Native button, sole activation/focus target. |
| `part="spinner"` | Shared decorative busy indicator, `aria-hidden=true`. |
| Documented custom properties | `--odd-button-radius`, `--odd-button-background`, `--odd-button-color`, `--odd-button-border-color`, `--odd-button-height`, `--odd-button-padding-inline`. |

Keep `hostStyles`, `buttonStructuralStyles`, `spinnerStyles`, `focusRingStyles` and `buttonStyles` layering; preserve skin-free foundation exports and side-effect-free `index.ts`. Only `.define.ts` registers. Shared description rendering remains internal. Alternative templates retain native control/slot/naming relationships. No nested link, button, input or other interactive descendant inside the action.

## 4. Events and outcome boundary

| Event | Trigger and timing | Flags / payload / default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `click` | Native pointer/keyboard activation or explicit platform click. Suppressed at host capture while loading/effectively disabled | Native click semantics. Cancelable click prevents later proxy submit/reset and rolls back local toggle flip. Ordinary action handling belongs to host. |
| `input` | Only an accepted user toggle activation; after click dispatch and local pressed update through scoped zero-delay callback | Source definition: bubbles true, composed true, cancelable false, `syncs:'pressed'`, intent user; no business-result payload. Read `pressed`. |
| `change` | Immediately after toggle `input` in that callback | Source definition: bubbles true, composed false, cancelable false, intent user; read pressed, no operation outcome. |

Programmatically changing `pressed`/loading/disabled/appearance emits neither input nor change. On a toggle, click listeners observe the provisional new pressed value; a canceled click restores it before input/change. No synthesized success/error or intent event is added. Host requests/results must not be inferred from Figma prototype navigation.

## 5. State matrix for editable design

Use one canonical Button family. Appearance, size, interaction, content and toggle are independent dimensions; specimen coverage need not duplicate every irrelevant Cartesian combination. All actual visual variants require explicit light and dark hosts and readback.

| Dimension | Required specimens |
| --- | --- |
| Appearance/size baseline | Primary, secondary, ghost × sm, md, lg in both modes. |
| Interaction | Rest, hover-capable pointer, active/down, keyboard focus-visible, native disabled, focusable loading; focus ring can coexist with loading. |
| Content | Text; start icon + text; text + end icon; icon-only with explicit accessible label; long spaced translation; unbroken identifier; RTL action. |
| Toggle | Off, on, focus on, disabled on, loading on. Stable label `Bold` throughout. Selected fill/foreground is invariant with pressed state. |
| Allocation | Intrinsic width; full width; narrow action row; full-width multiline; bounded parent with visible/reachable actions; no provider. |
| Async composition | Ready Save → loading; host success status → ready; host failure status + reachable retry → loading; withdrawn/canceled request → ready. Outcome text is outside reusable button anatomy. |

Disabled retains its appearance/pressed paint and uses existing opacity0.5. It is not a gray replacement skin. Disabled contrast is not evaluated as active text/control contrast. Readability still requires resolved themed canvases. Selection uses solid selection tokens in all appearances, not specimen lavender. Focus ring is external and must not be clipped by example hosts.

## 6. Proposed deltas and explicit unchanged scope

| Item | Current source observation | Proposed design / implementation requirement |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Loading footprint | Decorative spinner becomes a flex child on loading; no intrinsic unchanged-width promise | Center shared spinner over retained default/start/end content footprint. Use opacity-hidden content, not removal, preserving name/tree and measurements. Same control/slots remain. Compare width/height before/after with unchanged content. |
| Loading selected toggle | Selected selector excludes aria-disabled loading control; aria-pressed remains true but selection paint may revert to appearance | Keep selection background/foreground during loading as during native disabled. State is never inferred from hover/appearance. |
| Public API / event | Existing contract above | No new public members/events/dependencies/tokens. |
| Long labels | Existing emergency wrapping and narrow-source test | Retain and verify wrapping with both icons, full width, RTL and changing allocation. No truncation/horizontal scrollbar. |
| Async host status | Progress announcement is documented as host work | Show explicit parent-allocated status space in flows; no result text injected unpredictably into button siblings. |

These deltas are not runtime changes in this assignment. A later implementation handoff must name exact template/structural/skin tests and preserve foundation/native CSS parity where applicable. If the final Figma author chooses a different loading design, reconcile this proposed contract before handoff; do not silently claim one design with another rule.

## 7. Interaction transitions and focus

| Current + trigger + guard | State/event/default → next state | Focus |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Enabled action + pointer/Enter/Space | Native click; host handles action. If form type and not canceled, scoped callback runs proxy action | Remains on control unless actual action changes context; host directs focus for dialog/wizard/navigation. |
| Toggle off/on + accepted activation | Provisional pressed flip → click → input → change; new state retained | Same control; stable label. |
| Toggle + canceled click | Provisional flip rolls back; no input/change | Same control. |
| Host sets loading true | Same control, aria-disabled, decorative spinner; further activation ignored | Retain current focus; Tab still reaches loading control. |
| Loading + resize/theme/density/direction change | Reflow/paint only, canonical loading/pressed unchanged | Same focus/native node. |
| Host settles task | Loading false; external result/status owned by host | Keep focus unless host's committed result changes context; no automatic success focus jump. |
| Host sets disabled or fieldset disables | Native disabled; no activation | Native browser exclusion; host must manage replacement focus if deliberately disabling/removing current focused control. |
| Component removed/reconnected | Scoped listeners/timers cleaned; new connection preserves public supplied properties | Removal focus recovery belongs to parent. Reconnect does not announce an operation result. |

No Escape/arrow-key custom behavior belongs to plain Button. Menu/toolbar/roving-focus semantics belong to their actual composition. Icon-only actions need meaningful label and, where useful, an existing separately composed tooltip; tooltip absence cannot make the action unnamed. No editable draft or IME state exists inside Button; neighboring draft/selection must not be remounted by a parent rearrangement.

## 8. Conditional allocation contract

All rules use **Input → Condition → Response → Invariants → Owner → Mechanism → Fallback → Evidence**. No public measurement or runtime policy is required.

| ID | Input | Condition | Response | Invariants | Owner | Mechanism | Fallback | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| B-L1 | Usable inline grant after sibling gaps/insets | Full label exceeds content area | Wrap normally; emergency-wrap unbroken content; natural block growth | Canonical text, accessible name, action, node and pressed/focus state | Child text/layout; parent grant | Existing CSS flex/min-inline-size/overflow-wrap; shrinkable parent tracks | Stack/wrap action row in normal flow; never remove essential label | Source CSS and existing test inspected; Figma matching specimens; browser resize PROPOSED. |
| B-L2 | Explicit fullWidth | Parent provides finite usable inline space | Fill that grant, keep token insets and grow for multiline label | No viewport assumption, no truncation | Host sets fullWidth, child follows | Existing reflected full-width/CSS100% | Intrinsic default when false | Source PASS; design/browser separately observed later. |
| B-L3 | Narrow row with siblings | Combined minima exceed grant | Parent wraps/stacks actions using existing layout primitives | DOM/order/action identity, reachable peer controls and focus | Parent composition | Native flex-wrap/grid/minmax and existing logical gaps | Natural vertical action stack | Design fixture required; no per-button breakpoint/context. |
| B-L4 | Loading becomes true with same content | Async action active | Stable control envelope; proposed overlay spinner replaces only visual content | Dimensions, slots/name/pressed/control focus; activation suppressed | Child draws; host owns operation | Proposed local CSS positioning plus opacity-retained content; existing loading state | Explicit parent-allocated width can stabilize older source; no automatic current-source guarantee | Source gap observed; design requirement PROPOSED until browser equality probe. |
| B-L5 | Bounded parent block grant | Wrapped controls and status exceed block grant | Parent supplies named keyboard-accessible scroller or allocates reachable action region | Entire action text and peers accessible, ring visible | Parent | Existing ScrollRegion or native named region with deliberate allocation | Parent natural flow; never button-internal scroll/clipping | Design fixture; browser reachability PROPOSED. |
| B-L6 | Status/error text changes | Host task settles/retries | Update parent-allocated status region; button label remains action wording | Outcome owner, neighbors/draft identity, same retry control | Host/controller | Reserved expected status footprint or natural host flow with tested overflow | Parent named bounded region for unusually long feedback | Prototype simulation only until integration browser run. |
| B-L7 | Theme/density/RTL/root text scaling | Any active or rest state | Resolve existing tokens, logical slots and wrapping | Meaning/label, native node, focus/loading/pressed | Token scopes/CSS/host direction | Existing inheritance/logical CSS; no context import | Native baseline; parent may grow/reflow | Source mechanism inspected; exact Figma/browser/AT evidence separate. |
| B-L8 | Icon-only author content | Explicitly chosen action has no visible words | Named action at target-minimum or larger; same accessible name while loading | Canonical action/name, target usability | Author supplies label/icon; child control | Existing label prop/slot and semantic tokens; minimum target evaluated on real bounds | Visible text button if icon meaning is unclear | Design bounds; browser accessibility/target probe PROPOSED. |

Overlay permission, overlay collision, presentation arbitration, component scroll ownership and context subscriptions are **not applicable**. Button neither consumes nor creates an overlay. Host clipping must not conceal focus outlines; all parent fixture bounds account for external outline width+offset.

## 9. Acceptance fixtures and evidence boundary

Figma fixtures use parent grants240/320/640px as examples, not breakpoints/tokens, and explicit light/dark canvases. Also include a narrow intrinsic label fixture, standard/compact density, long localization with start/end icons, RTL, flow and bounded action/status compositions. Use actual Oddkin tokens for spacing, type, target, border, radius and colors; see [token map](./token-map.md).

Future browser probes:

1. `B-A1` — actual same native control/slotted nodes/focus/pressed preserved through640→240→640 parent resize; no horizontal prose/control scroll; all sibling actions reachable.
2. `B-A2` — unchanged text/icons before/loading/after have equal control bounds; loading suppresses pointer/keyboard/programmatic activation but retains focus and name.
3. `B-A3` — all appearance/size/selected/loading/disabled paint uses resolved themed tokens; loading-on and disabled-on preserve selection semantics; forced colors remain legible.
4. `B-A4` — Enter/Space; click cancellation rolls back toggle; exactly one input/change; programmatic changes emit none; focus ring not clipped.
5. `B-A5` — native CSS exact-submit path and custom proxy name/value/overrides/cancel/reset/fieldset/default-submit limitations are tested explicitly.
6. `B-A6` — icon-only named; nested interactive slotted content rejected/documented; target bounds and supplied long label/description are usable.
7. `B-A7` — long errors/status and retry in bounded parent remain reachable; neighboring textarea node/draft/selection survive action-row rearrangement.
8. `B-A8` — disconnect during queued activation/reconnect returns resources to baseline without stale action or duplicate listener.

Source inspection is PASS for the recorded observations only. This design document does not execute those probes, establish real AT support, establish historical-floor execution or equate root text scaling with real browser zoom. The batch Figma author adds actual node IDs, variable/mode bindings, screenshots, prototype endpoints and design review results before handoff readiness.

decision.md.text:
# odd-button — scoped architecture decision

- **Status:** Proposed design refinement; current public contract retained.
- **Date/revision:** 2026-11-15, source HEAD `e44c4fe4aff1b210cfff590fe908b93c88369ab7` plus current worktree; see `source-snapshot.json`.
- **Scope:** Button Figma specification and later implementation handoff. No runtime edit, new global policy, accepted-ADR replacement, or catalog migration.
- **Classification:** Foundational interaction primitive; ORCP level0 intrinsic.
- **Canonical owners:** ADR0001, 0003, 0004, 0036, 0038, 0041, 0042, 0043, 0045 and 0046 retain their status. ADR0051 remains Proposed. The detailed local API/layout contract is [contract.md](./contract.md); evidence is [research.md](./research.md).

## Problem

The user requests a complete redesigned primitive specification, aligned with existing Oddkin foundations and parent allocation. A button must remain a coherent action in narrow hosts and during loading. Current source already supplies native semantics, wrapping, token-based sizes and focusable loading, but inserts a hidden spinner into flex flow on demand. It does not state an intrinsic loading-footprint guarantee. A larger public responsive API would add machinery without a coordination need.

## Alternatives

| Alternative | Consequence | Disposition |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Keep public Button, refine local CSS/template and themed specification | Reuses semantics, tokens, events, parts, shared spinner/focus modules and native CSS path | Selected. |
| Add an adaptive/pending Button controller or per-button layout provider | Distributes space/policy for a problem solved intrinsically; adds lifecycle and coupling | Declined; no demonstrated responsibility. |
| Add compact/icon-only-at-breakpoint presentation | Hides action wording and changes meaning/accessibility when space shrinks | Declined; explicit author content determines icon-only use. |
| Give Button async success/error/cancel status and result events | Competes with host operation owner and implies click equals result | Declined. Host status/error composition remains external. |
| Replace all public Buttons with native CSS | Strong native form parity, but discards useful composition, focusable loading and current public behavior | Keep as documented alternative where native submit semantics matter. |
| Keep loading spinner beside text with width growth | Source-compatible, but can move siblings unless parent explicitly allocates stable space | Retain as current-source observation, not preferred default design. |
| Preserve content footprint and overlay loading ring | No measurements, fixed arbitrary width or invisible permanent side slots; accessible label and native node persist | Proposed internal visual/template refinement. |

## Decision and invariants

Keep `odd-button` an action-only, native-backed foundational primitive with the existing three appearances/three sizes and optional binary toggle. It supplies its label, interaction surface and local pressed semantics. Host/controller owns loading, permission, task result, navigation, focus destinations after context changes and status announcements.

Use complete wrapping labels and natural block growth within the parent's inline grant. The parent owns action-row stacking/wrapping and any named bounded scroll region. A button has no overlay, scroll region, overflow menu, runtime layout policy or width-selected semantics. The native control, canonical action text, slotted content identity, focus and pressed state persist during allocation/theme/density/direction changes.

For loading, propose retaining the existing content's intrinsic layout and accessible name while making its visual content transparent and placing the shared decorative spinner centrally over that footprint. The same control remains focusable and activation-suppressed. A host-allocated status area says what operation is pending and reports its eventual success/failure; loading does not invent those outcomes. A host changing label or slots is a separate content update and cannot inherit an unchanged-width guarantee.

No new public prop, event, controller, dependency, token, context key or custom element is proposed. The internal loading treatment must be validated in source/browser before being advertised as shipped. An implementation must consider the skin-free foundation/native CSS parity and update examples/generated metadata only through authored source and generators.

## Impact, costs and verification

Button is consumed by the listed AI compositions in [context](./context.md), and by native CSS consumers such as Calendar/ColorPicker. Any future internal loading change requires derived/foundation, native parity where applicable, slot/name, disabled/toggle, form and cleanup regression checks; visual-only assignment does not migrate those consumers. Avatar and Badge are independent data/display primitives; an action-row example may reuse Button without creating a dependency in their definitions.

Benefits are predictable allocation, fewer state owners and no added responsive runtime. Costs are a visual change from spinner-before-text, deliberate progress-announcement composition, and retained hidden content during loading. The existing proxy form limitations remain. Exact support and assistive-technology behavior need implementation evidence.

Required design evidence: actual themed variants, wrapped long/RTL labels, target/focus bounds, allocations and valid prototype flows. Required later browser evidence: same control/slots/focus/pressed state across resize; loading before/after footprint equality when content is unchanged; activation suppression; cancelable click rollback; disabled fieldset; native submit path/proxy limitations; external status/error reachability; reconnect cleanup. Real AT/zoom is recorded separately. No criterion here is a passing browser run.

Revisit if a real destructive action needs tone semantics, public multi-state toggles are requested, loading must visibly coexist with action text, or a source-backed consumer cannot satisfy the intrinsic allocation contract.

# odd-button — research comparison

Accessed 2026-11-15 against the source revision recorded in [context](./context.md). This investigation asks which semantics Button should own, how pending activation preserves focus and layout, and whether compact allocation requires a new primitive/context API. Sources below were opened and read, not inferred from search snippets. This is standards/source/design evidence, not a fresh browser or screen-reader run.

## Source register

| ID | Primary source / version | Inspected artifact and claim |
| --- | --- | --- |
| B-S1 | [WHATWG HTML Button](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/form-elements.html#the-button-element), Living Standard dated 2026-11-14 in fetched page | Native button model, types, form attributes and content restriction; interactive descendants are excluded. |
| B-S2 | [WAI APG Button](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/button/), current guidance | Action versus link, Enter/Space, action-dependent focus, stable labels for `aria-pressed` toggles. APG is guidance rather than a normative HTML requirement. |
| B-S3 | [WCAG 2.2 Reflow understanding](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/reflow.html) | Explains SC1.4.10's information/functionality and two-dimensional-scroll constraints; fixture width alone does not certify conformance. |
| B-S4 | [WCAG 2.2 Target Size Minimum understanding](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/target-size-minimum.html) | Explains SC2.5.8, 24 CSS px target/spacing alternatives; larger targets can improve usability. |
| B-S5 | [CSS Text3 §5.4](https://www.w3.org/TR/css-text-3/#overflow-wrap-property) | `anywhere` creates emergency wrap opportunities without changing the canonical text and affects min-content sizing. |
| B-I1 | [React Aria Button](https://react-aria.adobe.com/Button), current docs; [actual Button.tsx](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/adobe/react-spectrum/main/packages/react-aria-components/src/Button.tsx), mutable main snapshot | `isPending` retains focusability while suppressing actions; source uses `aria-disabled`, pending interaction filtering and progress/naming context. Exact commit/version not exposed by fetched artifact; re-read before implementation. |
| B-I2 | [Shoelace Button](https://shoelace.style/components/button), **2.20.1**, sunset/no active development; [pinned implementation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shoelace-style/shoelace/v2.20.1/src/components/button/button.component.ts) | Documents stable width during loading; has slots, sizes, loading, link mode and broader variants. Its pinned Lit/form implementation is independent of React Aria; sunset status limits suitability as a dependency recommendation. |
| B-I3 | [Carbon Button guidelines](https://www.carbondesignsystem.com/building-blocks/core/components/button/guidelines), stable page updated 2026-10-15; [actual Button.tsx](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/carbon-design-system/carbon/main/packages/react/src/components/Button/Button.tsx), mutable main | Official overflow guidance wraps labels rather than truncating; implementation exposes a broader product API and separate icon-only handling. Current exact package release was not established. |

These are three independent production systems, not three wrappers around the same widget. No external implementation is added to Oddkin.

## Architectural comparison

| Dimension | Native / Oddkin current | React Aria | Shoelace | Carbon | Oddkin conclusion |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Responsibility and semantics | Native action; Oddkin renders a real shadow button and documents a native CSS alternative for exact submitter/default-button semantics | React button primitive with normalized press handling | Web component can switch button/anchor by href | Product button can become link and branches to icon-only component | Keep action-only Oddkin semantics. Navigation uses the existing link path, not a new href union. B-S1/S2. |
| Public state/API | Oddkin has three appearances, three sizes, loading, disabled, optional toggle/pressed and form overrides | Pending and disabled are distinct | Loading/disabled plus many visual variants | Broader kinds, sizing and icon props | Reuse Oddkin vocabulary/slots rather than copy a foreign API. No new tone/destructive, compact, responsive, outcome or icon prop. |
| State ownership | Button owns local pressed behavior; host supplies loading/disabled and owns async result | Host supplies pending | Host supplies loading | Product/application supplies action result | A click cannot imply successful save. Host status/error and retry composition remain outside Button. |
| Events and control | Native click; toggle's source-defined input/change after accepted activation | Normalized onPress family | Component wraps native interaction/form controller | React click/native prop forwarding | Preserve native click and current input/change contract; no new onPress abstraction. |
| Keyboard/focus | Enter/Space; native disabled excludes focus, loading remains focusable | Pending retains focus | API offers focus/click/blur | Native-backed interactions, icon-only accessible descriptions | Preserve current loading versus disabled distinction. Existing Oddkin behavior is closer to React Aria than Carbon's disabled-loading guidance; no consensus is claimed. |
| Naming/announcement | Slotted text or label; decorative spinner, host must announce progress | Progress context and pending announcement are built in | Spinner rendered as child | Icon descriptions checked in source | Keep the visible action label stable; host region conveys saving/result. Oddkin does not gain built-in announcement behavior merely by matching a spinner design. |
| Parent allocation | CSS intrinsic sizing; label `overflow-wrap:anywhere`; native CSS path | Application CSS remains responsible | Explicit width styles supported | Official label overflow guidance wraps | Wrap complete labels within the actual grant and allow natural block growth. Width must not remove text or replace a labeled action with an icon. B-S3/S5. |
| Loading layout | Current hidden spinner does not reserve intrinsic width | Docs describe preserving label footprint | Stable loading width explicitly documented | Inline loading composition is separately documented | Proposed overlay spinner with retained content footprint is justified; no pixel measurement/context system required. |
| Composition/theming | Definition shares host/focus/spinner structural modules; skin reads authored semantic tokens | React contexts/render props | Lit controllers/CSS tokens | Product kinds and icon components | Preserve existing Oddkin parts/slots/definition and token pipeline. Product styling stays Oddkin. |
| Continuity/cost | No runtime allocation transport needed | Framework-specific lifecycle | Web-component lifecycle/controllers | React lifecycle | CSS-first intrinsic contract; no provider, subscriber, resize observer, remount, sibling scan or measured width cache. Browser continuity still needs implementation probes. |

## Findings, alternatives and limits

1. Preserve the public action/native-form split. The proxy's limitations are intrinsic to the current custom-element strategy and already documented; a Figma form example must not imply `requestSubmit(oddButton)` or implicit default-submit parity. B-S1 plus inspected Oddkin source.
2. Preserve full labels. Carbon directly supports wrapping, and CSS Text provides the mechanism. The inference is a source-aligned Oddkin design rule, not a claim that every production system uses multiline buttons. B-I3/B-S5.
3. Preserve focus during temporary loading and retain the control's footprint. React Aria supports the focus choice; Shoelace provides an independent loading-layout comparison. Oddkin can achieve the footprint with local CSS/template refinement rather than a new public property. This is proposed, not measured in current source. B-I1/B-I2.
4. Keep async outcomes outside Button. Error/success text belongs in a parent-allocated status area, with retry expressed by the existing button. This is the architecture inference from minimal ownership and current Oddkin boundaries; no foreign library API is copied.
5. Preserve current selection colors and disabled opacity rather than invent gray/danger variants. That follows accepted ADR0041/0042/0045 and existing source, even where comparison systems differ.

Exact fetched main-branch implementation commits remain a refresh limitation. Native keyboard/form/focus semantics have existing source tests but were not executed by this design report. Real AT, browser zoom and floor-browser checks remain future implementation verification. Revisit on public API changes, a future destructive-button assignment, or evidence that retained-content loading cannot satisfy a real consumer.

# odd-button — architecture and interaction specification

- **Revision/date:**2026-11-15; `codex/primitive-architect`, HEAD `e44c4fe4aff1b210cfff590fe908b93c88369ab7` with existing worktree changes; Button source fingerprints in `source-snapshot.json`.
- **Work:** design-mode redesign; runtime implementation remains a later linked phase.
- **Figma:** [Dedicated Button specification](https://www.figma.com/design/E7LfRysny8V3qU24tv082i/Oddkin---Design-Framework?node-id=1398-2), page `1398:2`; canonical set IDs `159:439`, `181:2332`, `181:2390`, `159:501`; native spec `1398:2760`. Actual authoring and refinement evidence records preserved masters and added coverage.
- **Status:** public API retained; internal loading-footprint and selected-loading paint refinements Proposed. This record alone certifies no browser/AT result.
- **Related records:** [context](./context.md), [research](./research.md), [scoped decision](./decision.md), [full contract](./contract.md), [token map](./token-map.md).

## 1. Overview and classification

Button is a foundational interaction primitive for an action. Keep and refine the existing native-backed `odd-button`, skin-free foundation and native `<button class="odd-button">` CSS path. Its smallest coherent responsibility is a named, activatable control with optional binary toggle state. It is not navigation, an operation record, notification, menu or identity renderer. ORCP level0 intrinsic needs no runtime context/controller.

## 2. Research summary and source references

The [research comparison](./research.md) records opened primary sources: WHATWG Button, WAI APG, WCAG Reflow/Target Size, CSS Text and three independent production implementations—React Aria, pinned Shoelace2.20.1 and Carbon. Native semantics and stable toggle labels favor existing Oddkin behavior. React Aria supports focusable pending; Shoelace explicitly preserves loading width; Carbon recommends wrapping long labels. Their extra APIs, visual grammar and differing loading behavior do not become Oddkin requirements. Mutable main revisions and unexecuted browser/AT tests are explicit limits.

Inspected independent implementations: [React Aria Button](https://react-aria.adobe.com/Button), [Shoelace Button 2.20.1](https://shoelace.style/components/button), and [Carbon Button guidelines](https://www.carbondesignsystem.com/building-blocks/core/components/button/guidelines). These primary links remain portable in the native Figma spec; the repository research report records versions, inspected source and limits.

## 3. Architecture and responsibility boundaries

| Fact/state | Authority | Boundary/mechanism |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Native control, focus, local hover/down | Button/platform | One retained native button in open shadow root with delegatesFocus. |
| Binary pressed | Button, externally writable property | Local accepted activation flips; canceled click rolls back. |
| Loading/disabled inputs | Host, plus native fieldset for effective disabled | Component renders/suppresses activation; does not run an async task. |
| Label/icons and operation identity | Host | Default/start/end content and label; same content survives parent reflow. |
| Inline/block grant, sibling arrangement, scroll region | Parent | Existing CSS layouts/explicit named scroller. |
| Request, committed result, retry/error/status, navigation | Host/controller | Never inferred from click or spinner. |
| Form validation/data/reset | Associated form/platform | Current documented temporary native submit/reset proxy. |

Shared host/focus/spinner/description modules are reused. No Avatar/Badge runtime dependency exists in either direction. Consumers include public AI compositions; native CSS consumers retain their distinct semantics. Accepted ADR0003/0004/0036/0043/0045 govern state, cleanup, composition and vocabulary.

## 4. Component anatomy

Semantic tree: host → native `<button part="control" type="button">` → decorative `<span part="spinner" aria-hidden="true">`, logical start slot, default label container/slot, logical end slot. Shared hidden description text supports an existing external description source. The native button is the sole focus/activation target. Icons are author content, not another public button API. The proposed centered loading ring retains the content footprint rather than detaching content/control. No interactive content is permitted inside slots.

## 5. Complete public API

All entries below are **EXISTING**; no new public API is proposed. Full exact validation/attribute details are in [contract§2](./contract.md#2-existing-public-api).

| Property/attribute | Type/default | Reflection |
| --- | --- | --- |
| appearance | primary/secondary/ghost; secondary | Yes |
| size | sm/md/lg; md | Yes |
| type | button/submit/reset; button | No |
| disabled, loading, toggle, pressed | boolean false | Yes |
| fullWidth/full-width | boolean false | Yes |
| label, name, value | string empty | No |
| formAction/formaction, formMethod/formmethod, formEnctype/formenctype, formTarget/formtarget | optional raw strings | Yes |
| formNoValidate/formnovalidate | boolean false | Yes |
| form | readonly HTMLFormElement or null | Native association/getter |

Slots: default, start, end. Parts: control, spinner. Custom properties: `--odd-button-{radius,background,color,border-color,height,padding-inline}`. Inherited native methods: focus/blur/click; no business operation method. Events: native click; toggle input then change with no business payload. Input bubbles/composes/noncancelable; change bubbles/not-composed/noncancelable; both source-defined intent user. Programmatic changes emit neither. Invalid enums diagnose/fall back; boolean attribute presence means true. No readonly/error/status/tone/href/compact/context API exists. Only `.define.ts` registers; definition/index/foundation exports are side-effect-free.

## 6. Canonical visual design

Preserve primary/secondary/ghost emphasis, sm/md/lg token minima and existing semantic palette. Bind actual variables/styles; every variant is reviewed in explicit light/dark hosts. Primary uses action/on-action tokens, secondary surface/text/strong border, ghost transparent rest. Pressed toggles use solid selection colors in every appearance. Disabled preserves appearance/selection with opacity0.5. Focus uses token2px outline plus2px offset, without altering allocation. UI type is source-backed system sans14px/500 with1.375 leading at root16px; lg font size16px. Control minima32/40/48px standard,24/30/36px compact at that root size; these are minima, never fixed multiline heights.

Proposed loading visual: centered shared1em ring over opacity-hidden layout-retained content, preserving its name and dimensions. Selected-loading retains selection paint. This differs from current spinner-before-label/selected-loading fallback paint and must remain an explicit implementation delta.

## 7. Conditional layout contract

ORCP intrinsic; no context subscriber, resolver, observer, overlay or component scroller. Applicable strategies: natural flow, local reserved loading footprint and parent-allocated feedback space. Bounded strategy belongs to a parent composition. Width never changes an action into an icon/menu/link or changes density. Existing physical allocation uses CSS; a future source declaration must describe actual implemented capability rather than claim a browser result.

[Contract§8](./contract.md#8-conditional-allocation-contract) gives all eight fields for B-L1–B-L8: input → condition → response → invariants → owner → mechanism → fallback → evidence. Complete labels wrap naturally/emergency-wrap without canonical-string edits. Parent wraps/stacks peer actions when required and supplies block growth or a named scroller. No button-internal horizontal scrolling, text ellipsis or implicit sibling displacement. Node, focus, pressed/loading and slot identity persist.

## 8. Parent-context demonstrations

| Fixture | Allocation/owner | Content/context | Expected result |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Wide and narrow action row | Parent grants640/240px after insets; natural flow | Save + Cancel, unchanged meaning | Parent row wraps/stacks; same actions and focus. |
| Full-width label | Parent grants240/320px | Long localization with logical icons | Label wraps, control grows, all text remains visible. |
| Unbroken label | Explicit narrow grant | Long identifier/URL-like action text | Emergency wrap without horizontal scrollbar. |
| Async result | Parent reserves expected status footprint | Save → loading → host success/error/retry | Stable button footprint; external status explains outcome. |
| Bounded parent | Named region owns deliberate block constraint | Multiline actions and long feedback | Actions/status reachable; no clipped focus ring or button scroller. |
| RTL/text-size/density | Nested parent, both themes, standard/compact | Logical icons, long localized label | Slots mirror and text reflows; identity/state preserved. |

Fixture dimensions are acceptance inputs, not global tokens or semantic breakpoints. Actual grants account for sibling/gap/insets; no claim is made for zero usable space or a parent that refuses necessary minimums.

## 9. State inventory

| State | Owner/entry | Treatment/exit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Rest/hover/down/focus | Native local interaction | Appropriate appearance paint, focus-visible outline; exit follows native input. |
| Disabled | Host or fieldset | Native disabled, no focus/activation; retains appearance opacity; host reenables. |
| Loading | Host | Focusable aria-disabled; shared decorative ring; activation suppressed; host settles. |
| Toggle off/on | Local accepted activation or programmatic host write | Stable label Bold, aria-pressed and selected paint; accepted next activation flips. |
| Selected disabled/loading | Pressed + supplied status | Preserve canonical pressed semantics/selection; only availability changes. |
| Success/error/cancellation | Host operation, not Button | External status/error/retry region; no invented Button variants/events. |

Cover three appearances×three sizes baseline and all meaningful interaction/content/selected combinations in both themes. Toggle specimens may reuse existing toggle family instances without inventing another independent state owner.

## 10. Interaction flows

Action prototype: Save → host sets loading → host reports saved → loading false. Branch: host failure → external actionable error + same retry control → loading. Interruption/withdrawal → host clears loading and reports actual result. No click frame means a service succeeded. Reserve/allocate feedback at parent level. Keep Save's action label stable; host says Saving changes… separately.

Toggle prototype: Bold off → accepted activation → Bold on; second accepted activation reverses; canceled click returns prior pressed state. Label remains Bold. Pointer/Enter/Space activate; unsupported disabled/loading activations are no-ops. Parent resize while focus/loading/pressed must retain control identity. Figma links simulate state transitions; they do not execute native input, network, focus or announcements.

## 11. Events and transitions

| Current+trigger | Guard/owner | Next/event | Focus/announcement |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Enabled+activation | Not loading/effectively disabled | Click; host action or later uncanceled form proxy | Remain unless committed host action changes context. |
| Toggle+activation | Click not canceled | Pressed flip, then input/change | Same native control and stable name. |
| Toggle+canceled click | defaultPrevented | Rollback; no input/change | Same control. |
| Any+programmatic write | Host | Render new property, no user event | No automatic focus move. |
| Focused+loading | Host starts task | aria-disabled, no further activation | Retain focus; host announces progress as needed. |
| Loading+settle | Host result authoritative | Loading false; external status | Host owns context-changing destination. |
| Any+remove/reconnect | Scoped lifecycle | Cleanup/relisten without stale action | Parent recovers focus on removal. |

No custom arrow/Escape behavior; menu/toolbar semantics are composition responsibilities. No internal draft/selection/IME exists. Neighbor drafts and selected text remain with their actual nodes. No record/event revision schema is introduced for a plain action.

## 12. Accessibility contract

Use native button role/Enter/Space/Tab and source-delegated focus. Slotted action text names it; icon-only must set label. Visible wording remains in accessible name. Toggle reports binary aria-pressed and stable wording. Loading remains focusable with aria-disabled while activation is suppressed; its spinner is decorative, and host progress/result is announced separately when meaningful. Disabled is native and excluded from focus. Nonempty meaningful label, usable target and uncut outline are requirements.

Forced colors must retain a visible native button boundary, GrayText disabled treatment and distinguish selected Highlight/HighlightText; do not depend on opacity/color alone. Current selected-loading forced-colors gap requires future source verification with the proposed selected-loading CSS delta. Reduced-motion state transitions read existing zeroed duration tokens; shared spinner currently slows from0.8s to3s, and the design does not claim it stops. Root text scaling is not real browser zoom. Figma proves neither keyboard/AT behavior nor universal contrast/accessibility conformance.

## 13. Content and edge cases

Wrap long labels, compound/unbroken words and RTL script without changing canonical text. Keep icon artwork logical and noninteractive. Empty/unnamed action is invalid author usage. User-supplied icon-only choices remain explicit; width never chooses them. Changing host text/content during loading is a new content update and is excluded from unchanged-content footprint equality. Long host errors overflow through an allocated natural/named parent region, not invisible clipping. Overridden height remains a minimum. Nested interactive content, loading+disabled conflicts and disabled fieldsets are documented/tested. No truncation tooltip is required to recover essential action text.

## 14. Composition examples

Ordinary use: `<odd-button appearance="primary">Save</odd-button>` after importing `@oddkin/components/define/button`. Toggle: `<odd-button toggle>Bold</odd-button>`. Icon-only: `<odd-button label="Close">…decorative icon…</odd-button>`. Actual icons use existing canonical assets supplied in slots. Narrow full-width: existing full-width property plus parent CSS grant. Parent action row owns wrap/stack and feedback. In forms where native implicit submit/submitter matters, use `<button class="odd-button" type="submit">Save</button>` with `@oddkin/components/css/button.css`.

Custom Button's temporary native submitter is removed after dispatch; read FormData synchronously. `requestSubmit(oddButton)` rejects it, and Enter in another field never uses it as default submitter. No source-private shadow queries belong in consumer examples. Avatar/Badge can appear next to an action in a parent row; nesting an interactive control inside Button or assigning Avatar a button role is not the composition.

## 15. Token inventory and implementation mapping

[Token map](./token-map.md) inventories actual colors, typography, control minima/padding/gap/radius, border, focus, motion, density, opacity and intrinsic spinner geometry. Existing source paths are listed in context and fingerprinted. Figma author records actual variable/style IDs, mode values and binding nodes in final evidence. No new token is required; fixture dimensions, percentages/em spinner geometry and disabled opacity are explicit structural values, not token claims.

Proposed implementation targets: Button template/structural/skin for stable retained-content loading and selected-loading paint; meaningful browser fixtures for unchanged bounds/focus/name and allocation transitions. Preserve definition/parts/slots, shared modules, native styling path and skin-free foundation. Future implementation regenerates metadata/kits from authored source and verifies dependent AI compositions; design success is not that implementation.

## 16. Verification results and architecture decisions

Observed so far: actual source/API/styles/tests/consumers inspected; standards and three independent implementations opened; non-Figma contract/token decisions documented. Existing browser tests were inspected, not executed by this report. Batch Figma author records structural bounds, all actual theme/state variants, bindings, resolved canvases, screenshots, valid prototype targets and independent review before design completion. Acceptance B-A1–B-A8 in contract remain future browser assertions.

| Applicable decisions | Conformance / explicit gap |
| --- | --- |
| ADR0001/0003/0004 | Existing decision/property/scope owners retained; no global acceptance implied. |
| ADR0036/0043 | Existing definitions/modules/public primitive reuse; no new coupling. |
| ADR0038/0046 | Existing floor/gates/native CSS; no above-floor mechanism introduced. |
| ADR0041/0042 | Existing semantic palette/noncolor scales; actual bindings still require Figma evidence. |
| ADR0045 | Existing appearance/size/loading/pressed/slots/events retained; no unapproved destructive tone. |
| ADR0051 Proposed | Intrinsic CSS classification; no context consumer. Loading reservation is a scoped design proposal, not catalog-wide certification. |

No new numbered ADR is created by this per-primitive report. Shared governance writer assesses whether the eventual visual/template refinement is material, preserves canonical statuses and records dependency impact. Remaining real AT, actual zoom, historical-floor and implementation continuity limits are explicit. Finish design only after actual Figma defects are fixed and handoff matches the final design/source deltas.

## Live Figma identity

[Dedicated Button specification](https://www.figma.com/design/E7LfRysny8V3qU24tv082i/Oddkin---Design-Framework?node-id=1398-2): page `1398:2`, canonical component sets `159:439`, `181:2332`, `181:2390`, `159:501`, states review `1398:76`, allocation review `1398:2328`, flows `1398:2658`, native spec `1398:2760`. [Authoring evidence](./figma-evidence.json) records actual identities; refinement and final rendered review are separately scoped. These IDs do not certify runtime implementation.

# odd-button — authored token map

Source authority: `packages/tokens/src/generate/preset.ts` and `packages/tokens/themes/default.theme.json`, inspected2026-11-15; runtime skin reads `token()` from `@oddkin/tokens/refs`. Generated `default-values.ts` was cross-checked for default literals, not edited. This map does not claim Figma binding IDs; actual IDs/style bindings and resolved mode readback must be recorded by the Figma author.

| Property/state | Existing source token | Default resolved value / use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| sm/md/lg minimum height | `control.height.sm/md/lg`, clamped by `target.min` | 2rem /2.5rem /3rem; default root16px gives32/40/48px. Compact density0.75 scales eligible control heights to24/30/36px, never below target.min. |
| Interactive target floor | `target.min` | 1.5rem. Component source clamps block minimum; actual icon-only inline target also needs bounds review. Fixture size is not a new token. |
| sm/md/lg inline padding | `control.padding.inline.sm/md/lg` | space.xs/sm/md =0.5/0.75/1rem. |
| Adornment gap | `control.gap` | space.xs=0.5rem. |
| Block padding | `space.none` |0. Natural text height can exceed minimum; never fix multiline height to the single-line token. |
| Control corner | `control.radius` | radius.md=0.5rem; existing `--odd-button-radius` override. |
| Border | `border.width.default` |1px; secondary uses color.border.strong, primary/ghost transparent unless overridden. |
| UI type family/size/weight/leading/tracking | `type.ui.family/size/weight/line-height/letter-spacing` | System sans stack;0.875rem;500;1.375;0. Default root16px yields14px type,19.25px line box. Use actual available equivalent system font/Figma source style, document any font resolution difference. |
| lg type size | `type.body.size` |1rem; other UI role properties remain from ui in current skin. Do not silently change lg weight/leading to complete body style. |
| Primary rest/hover/down fill | `color.action.default/hover/pressed` | Light#6250e8/#5140cc/#4333ad; dark#b4a8ff/#c5bcff/#9b8cf0. |
| Primary text | `color.text.on-action` | Light#fff alias neutral0; dark#23252b. |
| Secondary fill/text/border | `color.surface.default`, `color.text.primary`, `color.border.strong` | Light#fff/#23252b/#868997; dark#242631/#f5f3fd/#858395. |
| Secondary/ghost hover and down fill | `color.surface.hover`, `color.surface.sunken` | Light#f0eff5/#f0eff3; dark#30323f/#111219. |
| Ghost rest | Transparent fill; `color.text.primary` | Host canvas/actual resolved background must be visible in theme review. |
| Pressed toggle fill/text | `color.selection.background/foreground` | Aliases action.default/text.on-action. Selected remains solid iris in all appearances. Proposed selected-loading consistency reuses these existing values. |
| Focus outline | `focus.width`, `focus.offset`, `color.focus.ring` |2px width+2px outward offset; focus.ring aliases action.default. Outside layout; host must allow space and avoid clipping. |
| Disabled | Existing whole-control opacity0.5, no new gray token | Retains appearance/selection underneath; current forced-colors branch uses system GrayText and opacity1. |
| Loading | Shared spinner currentColor,1em ring with0.15em border,50% radius | Intrinsic structural dimensions, not spacing tokens. Existing module spins0.8s and slows3s under reduced motion. Static Figma states do not prove animation/AT behavior. |
| State paint transitions | `motion.duration.fast`, `motion.easing.standard` |100ms/cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); token reduced-motion duration0ms. |
| Parent action-row gap/inset/status spacing | Existing `space.sm/md/lg` as appropriate to host anatomy |0.75/1/1.5rem. Root author selects actual composition role; no new button-private gap for siblings. |
| Review canvas/stage | `color.canvas`, optional `color.surface.specimen` | Canvas light#f6f5f1/dark#171821. Specimen surface is documentation-only, never selected-control paint. |

No new semantic token is required. Border transparency, opacity0.5, percentages, CSS100% fullWidth, spinner ems and document fixture allocations are explicitly structural/behavioral values rather than invented tokens. The retained-content loading proposal can reuse all existing color/type/spacing values.

Figma binding audit must show per-property exact variable/style IDs, light/dark resolved values, standard/compact density values and actual specimen nodes; names alone are insufficient. Unsupported font/effect/numeric binding fields must be recorded, not represented as bound. Contrast is evaluated against actual resolved themed hosts and active states separately from intentional disabled states.
